I acknowledge and agree to the Cancellation Agreement.

"This Agreement is a contract entered into between you (a user of Hilla APP, hereinafter referred to as \"you\") and the operator of Hilla APP (hereinafter referred to as \"we\") regarding the cancellation of your account (hereinafter referred to as the \"Target Account\") in Hilla APP. Before applying for account cancellation, please carefully read and fully understand all the contents of this Agreement. Once you submit the account cancellation application, it shall be deemed that you have accepted all the terms of this Agreement.
Article 1 Purpose of the Agreement This Agreement is formulated in accordance with relevant laws and regulations to standardize the process of canceling your account in Hilla APP, protect the legitimate rights and interests of both you and us, and clarify the rights and obligations of both parties in the account cancellation process.
Article 2 Preconditions for Account Cancellation To apply for the cancellation of the Target Account, you must ensure that the following conditions are met; otherwise, we have the right to refuse to process your cancellation application: - All in-APP assets have been disposed of: You have settled or properly disposed of all in-APP assets in the Target Account, including but not limited to virtual currencies such as gold coins and diamonds, props, equipment, virtual items in the backpack, and other in-APP proceeds. If you fail to dispose of the above-mentioned assets, submitting the cancellation application shall be deemed that you voluntarily waive all rights and interests related to such assets. We are not required to compensate for or return such assets, and will no longer accept any claims made by you regarding such assets.
Article 3 Account Cancellation Process 1. You shall submit the cancellation application for the Target Account through the designated channel in Hilla APP (the entry path: \"Me - Settings - Account Security - Cancel Account\"). 2. After you submit the cancellation application and complete the online identity verification, the cancellation process will start immediately. A 7-day cancellation cooling-off period will be set from the date on which the identity verification is passed. During the cooling-off period, if you do not log in to the Target Account, the account will be automatically canceled upon the expiration of the cooling-off period; if you log in to the Target Account, it shall be deemed that you have withdrawn the cancellation application, the cancellation process will be immediately terminated, and the account will resume normal use. To cancel the account again, you need to re-submit the application and comply with this Agreement. 3. After the account cancellation is completed, we will notify you through the contact information (mobile phone number or email) you have reserved. Upon completion of cancellation, the Target Account can no longer be used, and all data in the account (including account information, usage records, asset information, etc.) will be handled in accordance with relevant laws and regulations and our data retention policy. Except for the circumstances where data retention is required by law, we will no longer retain the account data.
Article 4 Rights and Obligations of Both Parties (1) Our Rights and Obligations 1. We have the right to verify your cancellation application and online verification information. For applications with untrue or inaccurate verification information, we have the right to refuse to process them and inform you of the reasons. 2. We shall handle your cancellation application in accordance with the process stipulated in this Agreement and promptly feedback the progress and result of the cancellation. 3. After the account is canceled, we will protect your personal information in accordance with the requirements of laws and regulations, and will not illegally disclose or abuse the personal information you retained during the use of the APP. 4. We shall not be liable for any direct or indirect losses (such as asset losses, loss of usage convenience, etc.) caused by your voluntary waiver of in-APP assets or account cancellation, unless such losses are caused by our intentional misconduct or gross negligence.
(2) Your Rights and Obligations 1. On the premise that the conditions stipulated in Article 2 of this Agreement are met, you have the right to apply for the cancellation of the Target Account and require us to handle the account cancellation matters in accordance with this Agreement. 2. You shall ensure that the online verification information submitted when applying for cancellation is true and accurate. If the cancellation application is rejected, delayed, or security risks (such as malicious operation of the account by others) arise due to problems with the verification information, you shall bear the responsibility yourself. 3. Before applying for cancellation, you shall back up the important data in the Target Account (such as usage records, personal information, etc.) by yourself. Such data cannot be recovered after the account is canceled, and you shall bear the losses arising therefrom. 4. You confirm that you are aware that you cannot log in to or use the Hilla APP services after the account is canceled, and the account and related rights and interests cannot be restored, and you voluntarily accept this result. 5. If there are unpaid debts or breach of contract behaviors (such as arrears of fees, violation of APP rules, etc.) in the Target Account before cancellation, you shall still bear the liability for repayment and breach of contract, and we have the right to pursue your liability through legal means."
Account Cancellation Agreement for Hilla APP

"1. Agency Tier can be upgraded by earning Growth Points: 1 EXP = 1 Growth Point. The higher the Tier, the more abundant the privileges
2. The tier system includes three mechanisms: Upgrade, Retention, and Downgrade. Upgrade Mechanism: Upgrade immediately upon reaching the required Growth Points for the tier.
Retention Mechanism: To maintain the current tier, full Growth Points are not required. You only need to reach 30%of the required Growth Points for that tier’s upgrade.
Downgrade Mechanism: If the monthly Growth Points are less than the retention requirement for the current tier, the tier will be automatically downgraded in the following month."
